entity: US detentions of immigrants who arrived by 2021 (long-settled residents), Jan-May 2026 vs prior years
what_we_add: 13,265 detentions Jan-May 2026 vs 3,490 in 2024 (3.8x), and the 1.9x figure for 10+ year residents vs 2019
